attempted_claim: Let X_3 -> Y_3 be the universal length-3 flopping contraction of a quasi-projective Gorenstein terminal Calabi-Yau threefold (Karmazyn/Curto-Morrison length-3 universal flop), with flop X_3^+ -> Y_3 and Bridgeland-Chen functors F: Perf(X_3) -> Perf(X_3^+), F+: Perf(X_3^+) -> Perf(X_3) via the fibre-product Fourier-Mukai kernels. Let W: Perf(X_3) -> Perf(X_3) be the Halpern-Leistner-Sam GIT window-shift autoequivalence for this GIT presentation, with kernel K_W in Perf(X_3 x X_3), and let T_J = FM_{K_J} be the Donovan-Wemyss contraction-algebra J-twist on Perf(X_3) with kernel K_J. Settle by proof or rigorous disproof: is W isomorphic to T_J^{-1} as Fourier-Mukai autoequivalences of Perf(X_3), i.e. is K_W isomorphic to K_J^{-1} in Perf(X_3 x X_3)? A complete answer proves the kernel isomorphism or exhibits a named perfect complex (e.g. a tilting-bundle summand or a thickening of O_C(-1)) on which W and T_J^{-1} disagree.
claim_type: Fourier-Mukai kernel isomorphism window-shift vs inverse J-twist
decisive_failure: No explicit Karmazyn/Curto-Morrison length-3 GIT presentation, window generating sets, tilting summands, contraction-algebra data, or Fourier-Mukai kernel formulas could be recovered in this pass, so neither a kernel isomorphism proof nor a distinguishing test-object disproof was possible; the negative literature search itself is documented in WORKLOG and target_exit.json.
